notes: Wonder by R.J. Palacio is a middle-grade novel about Auggie Pullman, a boy with Treacher Collins syndrome starting mainstream school for the first time. Core themes are kindness, belonging, facial difference, bullying, and friendship. For younger or lower-verbal SPED users, the picture book adaptation 'We're All Wonders' (also by Palacio) may be a better classroom match and would share most of this vocabulary. The word 'different' appears in the fixed core row — teachers may wish to swap it for 'unique' or 'stand out' in the fringe to avoid redundancy. The astronaut helmet is the most iconic visual symbol for Auggie and should be prioritised when sourcing his character image.
